test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Amongst six friends B, I, H, J, O and U, each has a different height. H is taller than only four other friends. O is taller than only one friend. B is taller than U but shorter than J. J is not the tallest. Who is the shortest among all the friends?
solution:
According to given information, we have the possible arrangements as follows:

​1. H is taller than only four other friends.

 ___ > H > ___ > ___ > ___ > ___

2. O is taller than only one friend.

 ___ > H > ___ > ___ > O > ___

3. B is taller than U but shorter than J. J is not the tallest.

 ___ > H > J > B > O > U

4. Thus, the final arrangement of heights is as follows: 

 I > H > J > B > O > U

Therefore, **U is the shortest **among all the friends.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option (1).**
